scope: Offline reconstruction of the latest recorded frames. No rosbag play, ROS nodes, motion commands or runtime configuration changes.
age_scope: Age at the rosbag recorder, not necessarily age at the Planning callback.
timing_match_limit: OBSERVED transition times do not mark every frame update; negative or unrelated transition ages must not be treated as frame processing start. The first matched frame has a preceding relevant OBSERVED transition.
counterfactual_deadline_scope: Counterfactual offline manager decision with one frozen recorded geometry and recorded receipt age. No ROS/Motion command is published; timings are from this analysis run, not the original callback.
limits: Human geometry is frozen per snapshot for offline geometry tests, not assumed static throughout the original recording.
Frozen-scene paths are not published or used as live motion commands.
Deadline timings are single analysis runs and use recorder receipt age; they exclude additional waiting before the actual Planning callback.
No full dynamic ROS execution or physical-human safety claim is established.
